variants.specifics: Brackenford: A townsman points to Halvard in the Moot Hall, who sends the player against Red Corwin on Crow Hill.

herald.speaker: Townsman
herald.text: Eek! I saw Halvard storm right into the Moot Hall in a fury!

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text:
Stranger! Thank goodness, help us! Rotten bandits have seized the watchtower on Crow Hill, north of town, and no traveler on the road gets by them with his purse! Red Corwin leads that whole wicked rabble!

Drive him off, and a fine reward is yours!

reminder.speaker: Halvard
reminder.text: The bandits still hold Crow Hill!

journal.text: Drive Red Corwin off Crow Hill.

variants.writer: Claude Agent SDK subagent, Claude Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5)

variants.specifics: Vurn: Pob the miner points the player to Mayor Durvin, who sends him after Grutt's Trolls and the stolen Hammer of the Mountain.

herald.speaker: Pob
herald.text: We'll hold the upper tunnels, but Mayor Durvin wants you in the Great Hall. Thanks for coming, brave Adventurer!

opening.speaker: Durvin
opening.text: Welcome, stranger! Ossric told me you would come, and none too soon, for we need your help badly. Grutt's Trolls came up from the deep shafts not long ago and stole the Hammer of the Mountain! Please go down to the Troll den below the East Shaft and bring back the sacred hammer at once!

reminder.speaker: Durvin
reminder.text: Keep whatever you find down there! Just hurry and bring back the hammer!

journal.text: Recover the Hammer of the Mountain from Grutt's den.

variants.specifics: Tarrow: Pibb points the player to Warden Ostrick, who sends him after Grisla the Bog Witch in the Black Mire.

herald.speaker: Pibb
herald.text: I'm late for Warden Ostrick's muster, sorry.

opening.speaker: Ostrick
opening.text:
It's a calamity! Tarrow fears nothing like the drowned dead and a horde has risen from the Black Mire! Each night they climb our stilts, and no boat will leave till they're gone!

Out in the Mire, to the North, dwells a witch named Grisla. Someone must break her spell and free our besieged hamlet.

reminder.speaker: Ostrick
reminder.text: Is the witch beaten yet?! Oh.... Well, they say her hut stands on stilts deep in the Mire.

journal.text: Destroy the witch Grisla in the Mire.

variants.specifics: Varnhold: Jask points the newcomer to Warden Ostrik in the keep, who sends him against Skarn's Trolls in the Old Gatehouse.

herald.speaker: Jask
herald.text: Tobrin sent you, eh? Then welcome to Varnhold, friend! We soldiers have our hands full with trouble these days. Go up to the keep and see our Warden.

opening.speaker: Ostrik
opening.text:
Stranger! You've come in the nick of time! Our garrison is in dire peril!

A hulking Troll called Skarn came down from the hills only days ago with his raiders. The Old Gatehouse is theirs now, and the North Pass is shut! With more men I would drive them out myself, but half the garrison lies wounded in the barracks. Should I march out with the rest, Varnhold would be left to fall!

Will you clear those brutes out of the Gatehouse, young sir? Do it and the garrison shall pay you handsomely.

reminder.speaker: Ostrik
reminder.text: Skarn still holds the Gatehouse! Beat him and your reward is waiting here.

journal.text: Clear Skarn's Trolls from the Old Gatehouse.

variants.specifics: Skarra: Lomm points the player to Mayor Ottrick, who sends him after Vashk the Necromancer on Heron Isle.

herald.speaker: Lomm
herald.text: I ferry all newcomers to Mayor Ottrick.

opening.speaker: Ottrick
opening.text:
Good day, young sir. I take it you've heard about our troubles.

There's a fat purse for whoever stops Vashk the Necromancer -- by any means. He and his Undead have been crawling out of the lake by Heron Isle for weeks.

Watch yourself, nobody wants to be pulled under by those rotting wretches.

reminder.speaker: Ottrick
reminder.text: So you're the one Dreyhaus sent us? He must think highly of your talents, seeing as the last fellow who rowed out after those Undead never came back!

journal.text: Cross the lake to Heron Isle and destroy Vashk the Necromancer.

variants.specifics: Zanthis: Wendle points the player to Master Ombrel, who sends him up the hill to drive Grelloch's Golems out of the Observatory.

herald.speaker: Wendle
herald.text: No, Master Ombrel can't wait while the Golems hold our Observatory!

opening.speaker: Ombrel
opening.text:
Greetings, brave Adventurer! Grelloch and his stone Golems have driven every scholar out of the Observatory!

Will you climb up there and smash those brutes to rubble? The Masters of Zanthis will pay a fine purse of gold, for no wizard here can read the stars until they're gone!

reminder.speaker: Ombrel
reminder.text: Up the hill path behind the Academy! Hurry!

variants.specifics: Fort Kessry: Fennick points the player to Commander Haldrek in the keep, who sends him against Gorrak's Ogres at the high gate.

herald.speaker: Fennick
herald.text: Ogres hold the high gate and the pass is shut! Have you spoken to Commander Haldrek in the keep?

opening.speaker: Haldrek
opening.text:
Hello. I am Haldrek, Commander of Fort Kessry. Gorrak's Ogres hold the high gate and breaking through them is no easy task.

I'll make you a promise, if you'll drive Gorrak from the gate I'll send word of your deeds to Belgard. How about it?

reminder.speaker: Haldrek
reminder.text: Go and break the Ogres' hold! Please make haste, for if left alone, Gorrak could bring his horde down on our walls, to be sure!

journal.text: Go to the high gate and defeat Gorrak.

variants.specifics: Ferrik: Mirta points the player to Mayor Thurgo, who sends him against Magrok's Imps in the Great Furnace, and Holk keeps the gate shut.

herald.speaker: Mirta
herald.text: I was told to send strangers on to Mayor Thurgo.

opening.speaker: Mayor Thurgo
opening.text: Quick, lad! Our forges are failing fast. You must clear the Imps from the Great Furnace before Magrok burns us all!

reminder.speaker: Holk
reminder.text: Sorry, stranger. The gate stays shut until Mayor Thurgo says otherwise. We do it to keep folks safe. The roads beyond Ferrik are far too dangerous for plain folk.

journal.text: Drive Magrok's Imps out of the Great Furnace.

variants.specifics: Vellin Cross: Pibbet points the player to Warden Brusk, who sends him against Thrungar's Ogres in the Old Toll Fort.

opening.speaker: Brusk
opening.text:
Big, stinking brutes! Down from the hills came the Ogres, and now not one road through the crossroads is open!

Warden Brusk, at your service. A brave champion is what I need. Their chief, Thrungar, holds the Old Toll Fort, I fear.

Drive him out, open our roads, and you'll ride north with the next caravan. Come along, and I'll point you down the east road to that cursed fort.

journal.text: Help Warden Brusk drive Thrungar from the fort.

variants.specifics: Tarrow: Pell sends the player to Mayor Brannoch, who sends him against Gorlak's Ogres in the old fort on Blackstump Hill.

opening.speaker: Brannoch
opening.text:
We were cutting barley when the Ogres came down from the hills. Kervan said you would come to fight their chief Gorlak, who holds the old fort on Blackstump Hill.

Please, if you drive Gorlak from that fort and open the north road, Tarrow will reward you as best it can.

reminder.speaker: Brannoch
reminder.text: You again! Still here!? Gorlak holds the fort. Why do you tarry?

journal.text: Go to Blackstump Hill and defeat Gorlak.
